scope: Static review of only the final sealer, README and future physical release plan; no sealing, model, qualification or hardware execution.

It packages the already qualified static model without building or executing it.

Rejects an existing physical_session in the offline worktree. It creates neither a vehicle process nor a provider, authorization, reservation or physical-session artifact. The certificate explicitly states NOT_RUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED_IN_THIS_SCOPE; updated operational state continues to forbid further physical activity and requires a separately qualified future release.

Creates the new sealed directory and copies exclusively; verifies copied source/build hashes; preserves the unchanged kernel and expected512-byte artifact. The preservation manifest includes new source/builds/reviews/tests, retained draft/failure evidence and named dependencies. Reused evidence content is only read and hashed. Read-only attributes apply to this new completed evidence.

The mutable global CURRENT and new CHECKPOINT are excluded from the sealed immutable file set. CURRENT is snapshotted before its authorized status update. Operational completion reporting does not fabricate a bounded physical read or human authorization.

Correctly specifies the minimum legal first512-byte/pass0/address0 request,13-byte request and523-byte response, exact data/reply/current-image hashes, and the unchanged kernel identity. It explicitly rejects the16-byte/CAL-ID-first alternative under this fixed sequential kernel.

Separates the recorded24-TX physical prefix from the synthetic25th exchange, virtual waits from hardware timing, and10,327-instruction continuation from physical evidence. Records122/122 checks and the preserved corrected draft. Explicitly states no bounded physical read occurred and that stock/current equality of this block cannot identify the full calibration or whole image.

Design only: it requires a separate native release, a523-byte bounded streaming receiver, malformed/fragmented/timeout/error tests, exact25-TX stop with cleanup, independent review and reproducible builds, a new one-shot session and new human authorization. It carries no authority to reuse the completed identity session or perform a second read, full acquisition or flash.

limitations: This static review does not execute the sealer or assert that a completed sealed certificate already exists.

Exclusive sealing is not transactionally atomic: a late filesystem or dependency failure may leave partial new output. Existing-output checks prevent silent replacement; recovery must preserve that evidence and remain offline.
The full evidence closure and native/static-model qualifications were already reviewed; this bounded packaging review does not rerun them.
The512-byte block matches both saved current.bin and stock. Neither this model nor a future successful read of this block alone can attest to the whole current image or calibration provenance.
Future native transport, fragmented response parsing, physical timing and vehicle recovery remain separately qualified and explicitly authorized work.
